selection_policy: Freeze required issue witnesses, regression fixtures and owner-required focused controls before new captures. Add unbiased SHA-ranked random100 independently. Optional historical sampled controls are retained but do not expand the required denominator solely from sampling membership.

patches.direct_semantic_trigger:
Subject: [PATCH] Own repeat/bilinear sampling for main-textured shapes

Texture-only binding left unrelated unit0 sampler objects active. Their state
superseded texture wrap requests, and the post-draw unbind made later instances
fall back to the framebuffer texture's nearest filter. Bind an instance-owned
repeat/linear sampler on every main-textured fill, including both geometry passes.
Keep named-image descriptor samplers and stop mutating their texture parameters.

MilkDrop3 code/vis_milk2/milkdropfs.cpp restores wrap/linear stage state before
custom shapes (WarpedBlit_Shaders -> RestoreShaderParams -> DrawCustomShapes).
Khronos GLES3 glBindSampler specifies that bound sampler state supersedes texture
state; unbinding alone would activate nearest filtering here.
ProjectM TV fix against upstream 4.1.7 plus patches 0001-0044.

patches.direct_semantic_trigger:
From: ProjectM TV contributors
Subject: Preserve signed motion zoom when zoom exponent is exactly one

MilkDrop3 ComputeGridAlphaValues (milkdropfs.cpp) computes nested powf on
the CPU. For finite negative zoom and zoom exponent 1, the effective zoom
is the signed base, reflecting UV displacement around the warp center.
GLSL pow has an undefined negative-base domain even with exponent 1.
Select the signed base only for this narrow case. Preserve the existing
positive-zoom and nonunit-exponent calculations and custom HLSL translation.
The shared vertex source supplies both legacy and custom warp stages.

Reference: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/OpenGL-Refpages/main/es3.0/pow.xml
This is a local compatibility repair, not an upstream backport.
